Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: In Step 6, the Planner incorrectly deduced that the paternal grandfather of Charles Bretagne Marie de La Trémoïlle (9th Duke) was the 6th Duke (Charles Louis Bretagne de La Trémoïlle). The logic used was: "7th Duke (Charles Armand René) is the father of 8th Duke (Charles Godefroy), and 6th Duke is the father of 7th Duke." However, the goal is to find the *paternal grandfather* of the 9th Duke. The paternal grandfather is the father of the 9th Duke's father (the 8th Duke). The father of the 8th Duke is the 7th Duke (Charles Armand René de La Trémoïlle). The 6th Duke is the *great-grandfather* of the 9th Duke. The Planner failed to correctly map the generational lineage, confusing the great-grandfather with the grandfather. The correct answer should have been identified as Charles Armand René de La Trémoïlle (the 7th Duke), not the 6th Duke.
